attributes.residual: CAPPED at real 198, 254/254 instructions, opcode multiset IDENTICAL, frame 72 and save set stmw r23 both already exact. The residual is exactly TWO fndiff clusters and this drive proves they are ONE mechanism, correcting the prior record's framing of them as two coupled-but-separate facts. It is a clean two-web callee-saved TRANSPOSITION: target colours strs=r30 and hres=r29, we colour strs=r29 and hres=r30 (the swap cascades into the scratch pair too - target's r24/r23 are our r25/r24), and each side pays for its own colouring with exactly one home-copy `addi`, at opposite ends of the function. THE CAUSAL DIRECTION IS NOW ESTABLISHED, which the prior record did not have: target folds the ADDR16_LO straight into the callee-saved home (`addi r30,r6,0 @LO` at +0x18), and BECAUSE r30 is callee-saved that instruction CANNOT be hoisted above the `stmw r23,36(r1)` that saves it - so its placement after the frame setup is a consequence of the fold, not an independent scheduling choice. Our object folds the LO into the volatile scratch r6 instead (`addi r6,r6,0 @LO`), which is therefore free to be scheduled up into the pre-`stwu` prologue gap at +0xc, and then needs a separate `addi r29,r6,0` copy at +0x24. The balancing instruction at the far end is the mirror image: at +0x36c the target loads s->fileLoopSize into the volatile r4, tests r4, and COPIES it into hres's home (`addi r29,r4,0` at +0x374) before also copying it to len (`mr r28,r4`), whereas we load straight into hres's home r30 and copy hres to len. Same opcode, same two consumers, opposite choice of which value lives in the scratch. AXES SPENT ACROSS BOTH DRIVES, all four distinct and all now recorded: (1) point-of-use deferral of the strs assignment - REGRESSED, multiset broke to DIFFERS, reverted; (2) hres/strs declaration ORDER swap - byte-NEUTRAL; (3) declaration/initializer SPLIT - byte-NEUTRAL; (4) array-decay respelling `&lbl_801174A8[0]` - byte-NEUTRAL. Three byte-identical results in a row on the declaration-shaping family kill it. DO NOT RETRY declaration order, declaration/initializer split, decay spelling, or point-of-use deferral on this function. WHAT IS LEFT: the mechanism is now named to the instruction, the register, and the MWCC-internal choice behind it (fold-LO-into-callee-saved-home versus fold-into-scratch-then-copy, with the frame-save ordering constraint as the observable consequence), which is the bar the exact-match mandate sets for a park. It is a legitimate postprocessor CANDIDATE only under a guard family that can carry a two-register permutation together with one instruction MOVE across the prologue boundary - it is not a pure recolor, so no rule was authored and no WEBFRANK-READY flag is claimed.
